title: Henry Meds vs FutureClinic: what you pay for GLP-1 medicine either way
summary: Henry Meds cost vs FutureClinic: compare Henry Meds' $297/mo compounded semaglutide bundle with a $40 FutureClinic doctor visit and no subscription.
body_markdown:
## What do you pay over a year for GLP-1 medicine?


As of October 2026, Henry Meds' fee "includes the cost of your provider visits, medication, supplies, and ongoing support" ([Henry Meds GLP-1](https://henrymeds.com/treatments/weight-management/glp-1-weight-management) ): $297 a month for compounded semaglutide injections ($3,564 a year), $179 to $249 for sublingual semaglutide, and $179 for liraglutide. That assumes you stay subscribed, and on multi-month plans "you may be required to pay out the rest of your balance" if you cancel.


On FutureClinic, a visit is $40 for the best-fit doctor, or a chosen doctor's listed price, typically $20 to $100 (optional memberships offer unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time, typically $25 to $100 a month). For a stable medicine, when the doctor judges it safe, one visit can cover several months.


If your doctor decides it's right for you, they can send an FDA-approved GLP-1 prescription to the pharmacy you choose, NovoCare, or LillyDirect, which takes prescriptions from any licensed prescriber ([Hims & Hers footnote](https://news.hims.com/newsroom/full-range-of-fda-approved-glp-1s-available-on-hims-hers) ). As of October 2026:


-


**Maker self-pay:** Wegovy's list price is $1,349.02 ([NovoCare Wegovy](https://www.novocare.com/patient/medicines/wegovy.html) ). Through[NovoCare](https://www.novocare.com/delivery.html) , the Wegovy pill is $149/mo at 1.5 mg ($199 at 4 mg; $299 at 9 and 25 mg) with delivery or local pickup; pens are $199/mo for two fills (0.25 and 0.5 mg, new patients, through December 31, 2026), then $349 at 0.25 to 1 mg ([TrumpRx](https://trumprx.gov/p/wegovy) ). Through[LillyDirect](https://www.lilly.com/lillydirect/zepbound) ,[Zepbound](https://futureclinic.com/blog/zepbound-or-wegovy-online-without-a-membership) KwikPens are $299/mo at 2.5 mg ($399 at 5 mg), and the Foundayo pill is $149/mo at 0.8 and 2.5 mg (2.5 mg reduced through December 31, 2026;[LillyDirect Foundayo](https://www.lilly.com/lillydirect/foundayo) ).


-


**Insurance and Medicare:** FutureClinic helps with prior authorizations. With commercial insurance, Wegovy's savings card lowers copays to as little as $25/mo ($100/mo cap;[Wegovy pricing](https://www.wegovy.com/obesity/what-to-pay-for-wegovy.html) ). Eligible Medicare Part D members pay $50/mo for Wegovy, the Zepbound KwikPen, or Foundayo from July 1, 2026 to December 31, 2027 under the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge ([Medicare.gov](https://www.medicare.gov/coverage/weight-loss-drugs) ).


Over a year, three or four $40 visits ($120 to $160) plus the Wegovy pill via NovoCare, if your doctor prescribes it ($149/mo at 1.5 mg, $199 at 4 mg, $299 at 9 and 25 mg), comes to $1,908 to $3,748 depending on the dose, versus $3,564 at Henry Meds.


## Who does each service suit best?


Henry Meds suits you if you want compounded GLP-1s in one bill, or controlled medicines like phentermine ($149/mo) or testosterone ($129/mo) as of October 2026. FutureClinic doctors don't prescribe controlled medicines (phentermine, testosterone, stimulants, benzodiazepines, opioids). Instead, prescriptions go to the pharmacy you choose, including mail-order pharmacies that deliver to your door, with a discount coupon. For ED, Henry Meds charges $150 per 3 months for 30 tablets as of October 2026. On FutureClinic you pay for the visit ($40 for the best-fit doctor), and if your doctor decides generic sildenafil is right for you, 30 tablets of 20 mg cost $10.53 at Sam's Club, $16.99 at Costco, or $29.78 at CVS with a standard[GoodRx](https://www.goodrx.com/sildenafil) coupon (Brooklyn zip code 11201, October 25, 2026).


Did you want a monthly compounded medication program and the ongoing subscription required to keep it, or did you just want a doctor of your own to manage your weight care? FutureClinic is built for people who simply want an expert physician with nothing else attached.


## Where to reach a FutureClinic doctor for GLP-1 weight care


FutureClinic works in 33 states and Washington, D.C., and your doctor must be licensed in the state you're in: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. If you don't see your state, try anyway.


Start at[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) or from your AI app at[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) , where your AI can draft intake answers from what you've already told it for you to check. Or send your AI:` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt` . Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.


FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
